results.detail: SqlCommand "Update Gen_agentsBase set gen_agentvalue = ? where gen_agentsid = ?": ? #0 -> Param_0 = balance (cy), ? #1 -> Param_1 = gen_agentsid; positional count and externalMetadataColumnId verified. Conditional Split Update Agent = !ISNULL(gen_agentsid), EvaluationOrder 0; a Conditional Split sends each row to the first true output. One UPDATE per (agent, agency) pair that passes HAVING, so for an agent with several pairs (several agencies, or with and without an agency) the last processed pair wins (no ORDER BY). SQL re-read: sum(isnull(gen_accountbalance,0)) as balance (cy) over UNION ALL of (a) gen_fundmain f join gen_agentcontract ac on ac.Gen_agentcontractId = f.gen_brokernumber -> ac.gen_agentname/gen_agencyname and (b) the same plus join gen_agentcontract acc on acc.Gen_agentcontractId = ac.gen_agencycontractnumber -> acc.gen_agentname/gen_agencyname; left join gen_agents / Gen_agencie; group by gen_agentsid, gen_agencieid, gen_agentvalue, gen_agencyvalue; having ABS(sum - isnull(gen_agentvalue,0) + isnull(gen_agencyvalue,0)) > 1 (the agency value is ADDED, as the claim says). No filter on gen_fundmain. Connection [CRM]; Unsupported. Precedence Create ETL Process record -> Update agents balance (DTSX:7072).

Re-check after fix: the "several rows per agency -> last wins" sentence is gone. The write condition now states that rows routed to Update Agency have gen_agentsid NULL and therefore gen_agentvalue NULL, giving one GROUP BY group per agency and at most one UPDATE per agency per run. It also states that HAVING reduces to ABS(sum + isnull(gen_agencyvalue,0)) > 1, so the agency is rewritten every run. Both points verified against DTSX:5061-5090 and the split at DTSX:5028/5036. Params unchanged and correct: ? #0 -> Param_0 = balance, ? #1 -> Param_1 = gen_agencieid (DTSX:5130-5142).

I re-ran claims.mjs after the mapping update: the DB origin Gen_agents.gen_pausereason is now INFL only, excluded via {db:"Gen_agents.gen_pausereason"}. Verified that every row passes the Derived Column. The only path into set 'pausereason' field is the OLE DB Source Output (DTSX:7064). The only path out of it is Derived Column Output -> script Input 0 (DTSX:7061). The component is synchronous with no row filtering. Its Error Output is unconnected and the gen_pausereason input has errorRowDisposition FailComponent, so no row bypasses it. gen_pausereason is replaced in place (input column with Expression): ISNULL(gen_licenseexpdate) || DATEDIFF("dd",GETDATE(),gen_licenseexpdate) < 0 ? 5 : 4 (DTSX:6055). ?: has the lowest precedence. For a non-NULL date DATEDIFF is non-NULL; for a NULL date the ISNULL operand is TRUE, so the result is 5. The result is never NULL, so the main.cs:74 guard always passes and OptionSetValue(4|5) is written; the original DB value never reaches CRM. Correctly not a fixedValue (a choice between two literals driven by gen_licenseexpdate). 5/4 labels unknown. GETDATE() here is the SSIS host clock, while the source SQL uses the DB server GETDATE(). Under clock skew the 4/5 split may not match the SQL selection. Data flow precedence: Set Gen_commissionpostponed (disabled) -> update agents commissionpostponed field (DTSX:7074) -> update agencies commissionpostponed field (DTSX:7075). A disabled task is skipped and treated as success, so successors run.

EvaluationOrder 0 = !ISNULL(gen_agentsid). Rows with both IDs go only to Update Agents. Agency value comes only from agent-less rows (NULL or unmatched contract agent).

GROUP BY includes gen_agencieid, so an agent with several agencies (or with NULL agency) gets several rows. No ORDER BY, so the last row wins. For agencies this cannot happen: one group per agency, see the Update Agencies verdict.

Re-check after fix. (a) Agent-less pairs: after an update the test is ABS(2*sum), so the row is rewritten every run. (b) Pairs with both agent and agency: if sum = agentvalue the test is ABS(agencyvalue) > 1, causing a needless rewrite. A needed update is skipped when sum - agentvalue is within 1 of -agencyvalue (|(sum-agentvalue)+agencyvalue| <= 1). Both follow from the HAVING at DTSX:5090.
gen_commissionpostponed != 1 rejects NULL in both sources. The disabled task used IS NULL OR = 0.
The only values written to gen_commissionpostponed are true (main.cs:73, both scripts) and 1 (disabled task). Nothing resets it.
